subject: Prospecta Health — replatform evaluation & capacity ask
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@prospectahealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Replatform evaluation and capacity ask — Prospecta Health

Hi Sergio / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Marcus and I discussed internally and we have a tight window to decide on our inference platform before the Q4 product ship. We’re being pushed by a competitor ("StratusEdge") who’s proposed a lower price if we commit to a 12-month contract, and their team is offering a side-by-side throughput trial.

Two constraints from our side: 1) any replacement needs to sustain peak inference at ~1.6M tokens/day with 50ms P95 on a mix of chat + classification, and 2) our procurement timeline is aggressive — we need an actionable procurement/MAP by 6/18 so we can close before our fiscal cutoff.

Can Redwood run a short benchmark that mirrors our traffic (we can share a small representative prompt set) and outline what committed capacity options look like (reserved pool sizes, burst policies, and SLAs)? Also if you have a template MAP and a procurement checklist, that would help our legal/procurement teams compare offers.

Appreciate a quick sync — we can do 30 minutes tomorrow afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Director of Product Operations
Prospecta Health
ellen.park@prospectahealth.com
(415) 555-0124

[Attachment: workload-sample-20260607.json stub]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@prospectahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Replatform evaluation and capacity ask — Prospecta Health

Ellen — thanks for the clarity and timeline. We can absolutely run a targeted side-by-side-style benchmark and produce a MAP that aligns to your procurement dates. Proposed next steps: 

- Quick kickoff (30m) to align workload slices and acceptance criteria — we can do 4pm PST tomorrow (6/8).
- 5-day controlled benchmark: Redwood will run two configurations:
  * Config A: reserved pool (m5-like) tuned for throughput (target P95 <= 50ms)
  * Config B: cost-optimized variant with intelligent batching + caching enabled
- Deliverables: throughput readout CSV, representative latency histogram, and a draft MAP + procurement checklist.
- If you need capacity guarantees, we’ll include an uplift path (reserve up to X GPUs / burst policy) and a commercial term that covers commit discounts.

Neha — can your solutions-eng team own the benchmark run and the CV (canary) plan? Lauren — I’ll sync on commercial posture and what discretionary credit we can offer for the pilot.

Attaching a short MAP template we use for similar replatforms; I’ll update it after the kickoff.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Exec — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@procureco.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Replatform evaluation and capacity ask — Prospecta Health

Sergio — thanks, that plan sounds good. A couple of clarifying notes from procurement: we will need a greenfield-style MAP with milestones tied to acceptance tests, and a legal checklist (data handling, SOC2, KMS, breach notification). Tom from ProcureCo is joining the thread to keep timelines honest.

Timeline constraints: procurement needs an initial commercial term and MAP by 6/18, with final contract signed by 7/2 to align with our deployment window. If Redwood can offer a short-term credit during the pilot and a clear reserved-capacity uplift path, that will materially help our buy-side economics vs StratusEdge.

We can send a sample prompt set this afternoon.

Thanks,
Marcos
Head of Platform Ops, Prospecta Health
marcos.velez@prospectahealth.com

[Procurement note: Tom Reyes (tom.reyes@procureco.com) will need a billing contact and a draft SOW]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@prospectahealth.com>, Marcos Velez <marcos.velez@prospectahealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Replatform evaluation and capacity ask — Prospecta Health

Ellen / Marcos — great to be working with you. I pulled together an initial commercial and operational offering to make the decision easy: 

1) Pilot terms (5-day benchmark)
   - Redwood will run the workload you provide in a pre-prod environment instrumented for metrics collection.
   - We’ll provide a one-time $10k pilot credit for measurement consumption (applied to the first invoice if you go live).

2) Committed uplift option (if you choose reserved capacity)
   - Tier 1: Reserve 8 GPUs (baseline) — supports ~1.2–1.8M tokens/day depending on prompt mix.
   - Tier 2: Reserve 16 GPUs — supported throughput headroom for growth and burst.
   - Burst policy: 2x short-burst available for 15 minutes with pre-warming.

3) SLA and verification
   - Target P95 latency: 50ms (chat mix), 90% of weekdays during the committed window.
   - Verification: side-by-side throughput CSV and latency histograms; automatic rollback if acceptance thresholds fail.

4) Commercial flexibility
   - 10% discount on committed usage for 12-month term; additional 5% credit if you commit before 2026-07-02.
   - If you require a migration runway longer than 60 days, we can offer graduated discounts and a dedicated onboarding engineer.

Next steps:
- Confirm kickoff (6/8 at 4pm PST) and share workload sample.
- Neha will coordinate the benchmark; Sergio and I will finalize the MAP and SOW draft.

Attaching: throughput-readout-20260610.csv (example output from similar customer), proposal-prospecta-2026.pdf (initial commercial).

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Account Lead
Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147
